trips.T1: Q train, northbound, from Times Sq-42 St to 72 St (2 Av), Manhattan
trips.T2: F train, Manhattan-bound (northbound), from Jay St-MetroTech (Brooklyn) to 57 St (6 Av), Manhattan
trips.T3: 7 train, Flushing-bound, from Grand Central-42 St to Flushing-Main St, Queens

items.text: Attention customers. Northbound Q trains are not running between Times Square-42 Street and 72 Street. Please take the N or R train to Lexington Avenue-59 Street and transfer to the 6.
Attention please. Northbound F trains are running with delays of about 20 minutes because of a sick customer at Delancey Street-Essex Street.
Flushing-bound 7 express trains are suspended. 7 local trains are running with delays. Expect waits of up to 15 minutes at Grand Central.
Stand clear of the closing doors, please.
This is a Brooklyn-bound A train. The next stop is Jay Street-MetroTech.
Due to track maintenance, L trains are not running between 8 Avenue and Bedford Avenue this weekend.
Attention customers at Jay Street-MetroTech. Manhattan-bound F trains are running on the A line to West 4 Street. For York Street and East Broadway, take the shuttle bus.
If you have lost an item on the train, please see the station agent or visit the lost and found.
The next uptown Q train will arrive in 6 minutes.
Due to an earlier incident, there is no 7 train service between Queensboro Plaza and Flushing-Main Street. Free shuttle buses are available.
N and W trains are delayed because of a train with mechanical problems at Astoria-Ditmars Boulevard.
Attention passengers. The downtown 1 train is running local from 96 Street to South Ferry.
Attention customers at Times Square. Uptown Q trains are now boarding on the express track, across the platform, on track 3.
Please do not hold the doors. There is another train directly behind this one.
Attention F train customers. This weekend Manhattan-bound F trains will skip 57 Street and end at 47-50 Streets-Rockefeller Center.
Manhattan-bound 7 trains are running on schedule. There are delays on the 6 train in the Bronx.
Atención pasajeros. Los trenes Q en dirección norte no están circulando entre Times Square y la calle 72. Por favor usen los trenes N o R.
Los trenes F hacia Manhattan tienen retrasos de quince minutos por problemas de señales en Jay Street-MetroTech.
Atención. Los trenes 7 expreso hacia Flushing están suspendidos. Los trenes locales circulan con retrasos.
Por favor, apártense de las puertas.
Los trenes A y C circulan con retrasos debido a un incidente en la calle 59, Columbus Circle.
Recuerden llevar todas sus pertenencias al salir del tren.
Este fin de semana no hay servicio del tren L entre Manhattan y Brooklyn.
Atención. Este fin de semana los trenes F no paran en la calle 57. La última parada es 47-50 Streets-Rockefeller Center.
Q (yellow bullet). WEEKEND. No Q trains between 57 St-7 Av and 96 St. Sat and Sun, all day. Take the N to Lexington Av/59 St and transfer to the 6.
F (orange bullet). WEEKEND. Manhattan-bound F trains run via the A line from Jay St-MetroTech to W 4 St. No F at York St, East Broadway, Delancey St.
7 (purple bullet). WEEKEND. No 7 trains between 74 St-Broadway and Flushing-Main St. Free shuttle buses provide alternate service.
L (grey bullet). No L trains between Broadway Junction and Canarsie-Rockaway Pkwy. Take the free shuttle bus.
A (blue bullet). Late nights. Uptown A trains skip 50 St. Take the C or the E.
1 (red bullet). Downtown 1 trains run express from 96 St to 42 St. Late nights, Mon to Fri.

F (orange bullet). FIN DE SEMANA. Los trenes F no paran en 57 St. Usen 47-50 Sts-Rockefeller Ctr.
6 (green bullet). Los trenes 6 hacia el Bronx circulan como locales. Noches, lunes a viernes.
Q (yellow bullet). 72 St station. The 2 Av and 72 St entrance is closed. Use the entrance at 2 Av and 69 St.
If you see something, say something. Tell a police officer or an MTA employee.
G (light green bullet). No G trains between Court Sq and Nassau Av. Take the free shuttle bus.
J (brown bullet). Jamaica-bound J trains skip 104 St and 111 St. Weekends.
Station sign: Times Sq-42 St. N Q R W 1 2 3 7 S. Uptown and the Bronx.
